meta.revisionPolicy: NHB rebased RESIDEX to 2012-13, 2017-18 and 2024-25 (three bases, never joined here). Values are as served by the RESIDEX dashboards at fetch time.
meta.coverage: NHB RESIDEX house price indices, India and 50 cities, base 2024-25 = 100
meta.note: NHB RESIDEX (Dashboard). HFC = valuations at which banks and housing finance companies lent; UC = developers' prices for flats under construction (not published on this base). Keys without suffix are four-quarter moving averages; _q is the quarter alone. Zeros served by NHB are treated as missing.
